Real webcam captures (dev mode, key `c`) of an authenticator app showing the 6-digit code
`729 592` on a phone, used as OCR regression tests. `*-frame.png` is the full 640×480 camera
frame, `*-roi.png` the central region the extension feeds to the OCR. The `blurred` pair is a
harder capture (smaller digits, motion blur, strong tilt). The code was already expired when
captured.
